description: This file defines the Java class 'TaxConfiguration' which models tax settings for a merchant, including tax calculation basis and rules for collecting tax across different regions. It implements JSON serialization for the configuration.

classes.name: TaxConfiguration
classes.description: Represents tax configuration settings such as calculation basis and regional tax collection rules.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the tax configuration settings into a JSON string.

methods.name: setTaxBasisCalculation
methods.description: Sets the tax basis calculation method.

methods.name: getTaxBasisCalculation
methods.description: Returns the current tax basis calculation method.

methods.name: setCollectTaxIfDifferentProvinceOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Sets whether to collect tax if the province differs from the store's country.

methods.name: isCollectTaxIfDifferentProvinceOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Checks if tax collection is enabled when province differs.

methods.name: setCollectTaxIfDifferentCountryOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Sets whether to collect tax if the country differs from the store's country.

methods.name: isCollectTaxIfDifferentCountryOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Checks if tax collection is enabled when country differs.
